I cant seem to pass these tests on "freecodecamp.org" the main goal of the lab is to create a Flashcard-Quiz-App, using HTML, CSS and typeScript. Its supposed to be an app that displays and stores flashcard data that can be retrieved later. And so far on test #6 its asking me to have a button that when first clicked will pass a class named "flipped" to an element named flashcard. So far I made a addEventListener to set a currentCardIndex to that cards position. with an ".add" classList to add the flipped class and it seems to work better than .toggle, however I belive the bug or missing code, lies within the CSS or HTML files because the css wont load on the rendered window either. The latest error message that I have gotten is "Your code does not add the flipped class to the #flashcard element when it is clicked. Add a click event listener that adds (or toggles) the flipped class on the #flashcard element and try again.
